C0471.title: Former Employee Sentenced to 16 Months for Inflating About 3.69 Million Mall Points
C0471.summary: In August 2022, Xinmin Evening News reported a mall points theft case tried by the Jing'an District Court. After leaving the company, Diao repeatedly entered the mall during closing hours, used previously known credentials to log into the backend service system, inflated about 3.69 million points in two member accounts, and redeemed more than RMB 30,000 in goods. The court convicted him of theft and sentenced him to one year and four months in prison plus a RMB 10,000 fine.
